notes: "This is a small scientific case inside the HUANDENG story, not a DNA lecture. I downloaded 1BNA directly from RCSB and calculated paired C1-prime distances with NumPy, then drew this figure with Matplotlib. The points are measurements from one static structure; no replicate uncertainty is inferred. The two chain colors identify the deposited chains. The molecular projection is an illustration from real coordinates, with distance-based bond connections. Keep data, units, source and original figure when revising this page. In the Editor, Assets contains the original image and Files contains the data and script. Source: https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1BNA ; Drew et al., PNAS 78, 2179–2183 (1981)."

designIntent.purpose: Keep a professional figure, original data and a focused author request in one continuing page.
keep: Keep the original plot, coordinate-derived values, axis units and source citation.
designIntent.requestedChange: Make the title explain why the source stays with the figure. Change only that title.
